Get your first look at the Wyvern boss battle, accompanied by commentary from the game’s director. Wyvern, the dragon that rules the skies, is one of the game’s formidable bosses. What kinds of attacks does it unleash? And how should you make the most of Davy’s abilities to overcome this fight? We hope this commentary gives you some useful insights before taking on the battle yourself.

Stupid Never Dies launches on October 21!

author: PlayStation
description:
State of Play returns Thursday, September 3 with two broadcasts airing back-to-back.

First, tune in for a new State of Play featuring updates and announcements from PlayStation Studios and our third-party partners, concluding with an extended look at the vast world of Final Fantasy VII Revelation from our friends at Square Enix.

Immediately following, stay tuned for a new episode of State of Play Japan, once again hosted by Yuki Kaji. State of Play Japan will offer deep dives into upcoming games from game studios in Japan and Asia, including new gameplay, announcements, and more.

Watch both broadcasts live on September 3 starting at 6:00am PT / 9:00am ET / 3:00pm CEST / 10:00pm JST on YouTube and Twitch. State of Play will air in English, with Japanese subtitles also available. State of Play Japan will air in Japanese, with English subtitles available.

See you there.
Regarding co-streaming and video-on-demand (VOD)

author: PlayStation
description:
Starting later today, Live TV on PS5® by Sony Pictures will be available to PS5® players in the U.S., bringing more than 100 live channels and a growing selection of on-demand entertainment directly to the Media section of PS5®.

Discover movies, TV shows, anime, sports, news, creator-led programming and more — free with ads and no subscription required.

To get started, head to the Media tab on your PS5® console and select Live TV on PS5®.

Learn more: https://www.playstation.com/en-us/live-tv-on-ps5
Programming availability may vary by local TV markets and may change over time.

#ps5 #playstation
title: Introducing Live TV on PS5
